login.title: Sign in

status.recheck: Click to check the server again

drafts.title: Drafts
drafts.intro: Drafts of IRB submission and amendment forms, written by the AI from stored documents and each hospital's guide. Check every draft before you use it. Drafts are deleted 30 days after the last change.
drafts.confirmDelete: Delete this draft and all its versions?
drafts.usage: AI drafts and revisions used in the last 24 hours: {used} of {limit}
drafts.off: The docs generator is not available: {reason}
drafts.step1Hint: Pick up to {max} documents. The newest version is used unless you choose another; the changes from the version before are included.
drafts.tooMany: You can choose at most {max} documents.
drafts.aiOffText: This is a study source. Its document text will be sent to OpenAI to write this draft (nothing is kept there). Tick the box only if that is allowed for this study. Your choice is recorded.
drafts.aiOffAgree: I confirm the text of {name} may be sent to OpenAI for this draft
drafts.step2Hint: The guides an admin set for these sources. Untick a guide to leave it out, or attach your own (PDF, HWP, HWPX, DOCX, MD, TXT; up to {max} files, 5 MB each).
drafts.noGuides: No guides are set for these sources. The AI will use the usual sections of an amendment request.
drafts.fileType: {name}: this file type cannot be used as a guide.
drafts.fileSize: {name}: the file is larger than 5 MB.
drafts.requestPlaceholder: For example: the number of visits changed from 3 to 4; write the amendment request.
drafts.needAgree: Tick the box for each source with AI switched off.
drafts.writingHint: This can take a minute or more. You can leave this page: the draft is still written and appears in your list.
drafts.readOnly: Older versions are read-only. Editing continues from the newest version.
drafts.conflict: The draft changed at the same moment.
drafts.revise: Ask the AI to change it
drafts.revisePlaceholder: For example: make section 2 shorter and add a table of changes.
drafts.reviseUnsaved: Save or discard your changes first: the AI revises the saved newest version.
drafts.compareTooLarge: The texts are too long to compare word by word.
drafts.exportUnsaved: Save your changes first: the DOCX is made from the saved version.
drafts.notFound: This draft does not exist or was deleted.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.retention: Conversations are deleted automatically 30 days after their last message.
assistant.intro: Ask about the documents you can read: what changed, what a document says, or how two versions differ.
assistant.introNote: It reads only what you may read. Sources with AI switched off are not available to it. Answers may contain mistakes; check the original before acting.
assistant.usage: {used} of {limit} messages used in the last 24 hours
assistant.stopped: Stopped. The question was saved; ask again to get an answer.

errors.unreachable: Cannot reach the server. Try again in a moment.
errors.cutOff: The answer ended before it was finished. Ask again.

action.test_mail: Send a test email to your own address
action.weekly_preview: Send the weekly report preview to your own address
action.resummarizeWarning: This replaces the saved summary for everyone.

projects.title: My projects
projects.intro: Group the IRB sites you work with under a project, for example one per study. Only you can see your projects. A project does not give access to members-only sites; you can add only sites you can already read.
projects.name: Name
projects.notePlaceholder: Protocol number, PI, anything you want to remember
projects.confirmDelete: Delete this project? The sites and documents stay; only this folder is removed.
projects.siteUnavailable: Site no longer available to you
projects.noSitesLeft: Every site you can read is already in this project.
projects.sitesFull: A project can hold at most {max} sites.
projects.addSitesFirst: Add a site to see its documents here.
projects.noDocuments: No documents stored for these sites yet.
projects.noChanges: No new or updated documents yet. The first scan of a site is stored silently.

problems.nameLong: The name can be at most 100 characters.
problems.noteLong: The note can be at most 1,000 characters.

errors.nameTaken: You already have a project with this name.
errors.tooManyProjects: You can have at most 50 projects. Delete one to make another.
errors.tooManySites: A project can hold at most 30 sites.
errors.notAllowed: This was refused: you may only add sites you can read, to your own projects.
errors.invalid: The name or note is not valid.
errors.gone: This project no longer exists. It may have been deleted in another tab.
errors.saveError: Could not save the change. Try again.

sources.mayBeOld: Data may be out of date
sources.mayBeOldLong: The last scan of this source did not complete normally, so the documents below may be out of date. They are as of the last good scan.
sources.lockedNote: This is a members-only board. You need to confirm your hospital access to see its documents. Confirming access is not available yet.
sources.showAttention: Only sources whose data may be out of date

admin.name: Name
admin.testMailSent: Test email sent to your own address. Check your inbox and the spam folder.
admin.weeklyPreviewSent: Preview of the weekly report sent to your own address only. Check your inbox and the spam folder.
admin.scanStarted: Scan of {name} started. The result appears here when it is done.
admin.paused: Daily scans are paused: {reason}. Scan it yourself once the login works to resume.
admin.deactivated: The source is inactive: it is no longer scanned.
admin.loginLabelHint: Letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'. With a label the source is members-only and AI summaries start switched off.
admin.urlHint: A SNUH board link, or a hospital's R-BAY address with ?board=REGLA (관련규정), FORM_BOX (양식함) or NOTI (공지). An R-BAY board needs a login label; save the password on the source's page (one login per hospital).

list.counts: {shown} of {total} sources in {groups, plural, one {# group} other {# groups}}

bulk.label: Actions for the selected sources
bulk.scanStarted: Scan started for {n} sources, one site at a time. Sources already scanning or paused are skipped.

admin.aiDescription: When AI is off, no text of this source is sent to OpenAI or Jev: news cards get a plain line and summaries cannot be made. Summaries saved earlier stay.
admin.aiTurnedOn: AI is on for this source.
admin.aiTurnedOff: AI is off for this source.
admin.aiConfirmOn: Send this source's text to the AI services?
admin.aiConfirmOnStudy: Study documents may be confidential. Send their text to OpenAI and Jev?
admin.accountIntro: Scans log in to the hospital site with the login stored under the label "{label}". The password is stored encrypted and can never be read back.
admin.noBoardKey: This source address has no board key, so no login can be filed for it.
admin.rbayShared: R-BAY logins are stored per hospital: the boards of this hospital with the login label "{label}" share this ID and password, so a change or delete here applies to all of them. Other hospitals have their own login.
admin.loginMissing: No login is stored yet. Scans of this source will fail until you save one.

ai.title: AI instructions
ai.intro: Add instructions to each AI feature: tone, wording, terms, format. They are added after the fixed safety rules, which cannot be changed here (document text is never obeyed, no links or HTML, the chat cannot change anything). A saved change applies to the next AI answer, with no restart.

featureHint.agent: The chat every user can open from any page.
featureHint.docgen: Drafts of IRB submission and amendment forms. Hospital guides are added separately, per source.
featureHint.summary: Change summaries during scans and whole-document summaries; one text for all of them.

ai.label: Added instructions
ai.placeholder: For example: answer in polite Korean (존댓말); call the consent form '동의서'; keep answers under 5 bullets.
ai.default: No added instructions: the defaults are in use.
ai.saved: Saved. The next AI answer uses it.
ai.confirmReset: Remove the added instructions for this feature? The old text stays in the history.
ai.restored: Restored. The next AI answer uses it.
ai.testHint: Runs once with the text in the box (saved or not) and shows the answer. Nothing is saved. 30 test runs per admin per day.
ai.question: Question
ai.documentIdHint: The number in a document's address (…/documents/123). Sources with AI off may be used for tests.

guides.title: Guide library
guides.intro: Guides tell the docs generator what a hospital's submission form must contain. Upload each guide once and link it to the sources it applies to. Only the text is kept; check it after uploading.
guides.name: Name
guides.namePlaceholder: For example: SNUH amendment request guide
guides.file: File (PDF, HWP, HWPX, DOCX, MD, TXT; up to 5 MB)
guides.uploaded: Uploaded. Check the text that was read:
guides.notLinked: Not linked to any source yet
guides.confirmArchive: Archive this guide? It is removed from every source; old drafts still name it.
guides.fileType: This file type cannot be used as a guide.
guides.fileSize: The file is larger than 5 MB.
guides.sourceHint: Drafts from this source use these guides by default. Users can leave a guide out for one draft.
guides.noneLeft: Every guide in the library is already linked. Upload more on the Guides tab.

agent.title: Assistant limits
agent.intro: How many messages each person may send to the assistant in any 24 hours. A deleted chat does not reset the count. 0 switches the assistant off for that type of account.
agent.invalid: Each limit must be a whole number from 0 to 1000.

admin.passwordNote: Sent once over HTTPS, stored encrypted, never shown again. Pass the password to the admin through a safe channel.
admin.loginLockedHint: The stored login is locked. Click "Change login" to enter a new one.
admin.makeStudyIntro: Give the source an account label. It becomes readable only by admins and by users you assign, and AI summaries are switched off. You then store the study account here.
admin.membersHint: Only these users and admins can see this source and its documents.
admin.noMembers: Nobody is assigned yet, so only admins can read it.
admin.attentionBanner: {n} source(s) need attention: scans failed, are out of date, or need a person to act.

healthReason.paused: scans paused after a rejected login
healthReason.stale: no good scan for over 36 hours

settings.studiesNote: Documents of members-only studies are shown as a count only, never with titles.
settings.digestOff: The daily digest is off. You will not get these emails.
